description: This PHP source file defines functions related to system memory information, generating XML, HTML, and WML representations of system memory and swap usage data. It interacts with a global system info object and uses external functions for formatting and graph generation.

methods.name: xml_memory
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing current memory and swap usage, including detailed device swap information.

methods.name: html_memory
methods.description: Returns an HTML table displaying memory and swap information with graphical bars and detailed breakdowns.

methods.name: wml_memory
methods.description: Creates a WML card summarizing physical memory and swap details suitable for mobile devices.
